action_args.justification: The series is strongly trend-dominated (trend strength 0.80) with no seasonality and non-stationary behavior. Model ranking is unstable across the 3 validation windows (Kendall tau 0.29, no model is always top-3), and 7 of 19 models fall into correlated-error groups, leaving only 3 independent error sources. Under these conditions, a robust trimmed mean over the 5 most consistently-ranked models (pool1) is the natural choice: it avoids the high-variance weight estimation that only 3 windows support, trims the influence of the few models that degrade in a given window, and leverages the stable core of the CWT/DWT family. The leader's score (0.0379) is not statistically distinguishable from the runner-up, and the strategy type matches the series characteristics and the dataset-level evidence that trimmed-mean strategies dominate on this dataset.
